name: In-memory SQL engine from a spec
prompt: Build the in-memory SQL engine specified in SPEC.md, starting from the stub in src/db.ts. It must match SQLite's answers for the whole subset in the spec: parser, joins, grouping, aggregates, NULL semantics, ordering, writes and error messages. Hidden tests compare your engine with SQLite on many queries, including 5,000-row tables. db.test.ts is only a starting point; add your own tests.
